## Updates

- Easier-to-see selection in activity lists.
- Clearer tables in pull request descriptions.
- Smoother calendar navigation and Hub scrolling.

## Fixes

- Starting or resuming an entry now puts the cursor in the editor.
- Newly imported repositories now load activity reliably.

## Supported machines and installation

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit Intel or AMD (x64).

Download and run `weekly-j-0.1.2-windows-x64-setup.exe` from **Assets** below to install weekly-j.

See the [installation details](https://github.com/XII-A/weekly-j#downloads) for unsigned installer warnings and checksums.
